method: Each listed item was read with its stem, all options, keyed answer(s), explanations and takeaway. Statuses are manually reasoned, not inferred from a schema or automated pass rule.
limitations: Independent AI editorial/clinical-reasoning screen; not external clinician validation or psychometric validation.
Pass applies only to the recorded content hash. New or changed content requires further review.
No comparison against proprietary examination items; originality judged from author provenance and item content.
Cross-bank learning-objective overlap remains provisional until all batches are available.
Source checks below support only the explicitly associated claims; other category references are general reading unless specifically verified.

items.assessment: Adaptive utensils preserve demonstrated retained ability. Revised larger spoonful distractor is relevant but can worsen spills; the original unrelated reclining option is removed.

Distributing a prescribed allowance addresses documented early consumption. Medication-only evening sips is now a plausible inadequate allocation plan. No authority to increase restriction independently is implied.
Oral hygiene plus counting melted ice respects restriction while treating dryness. Alcohol rinse and unlimited ice are relevant misconceptions rather than unrelated food advice.
Sodium must be compared for the actual consumed quantity. Per-serving-only comparison is a meaningful distractor when package portions differ; calories and natural labels do not establish sodium.
A tolerated lactose-free equivalent preserves nutrient intake; unnecessary dairy exclusion and unfortified substitution require review. Cream tolerance cannot be assumed from size alone.
Regular oral cleaning remains necessary with enteral feeding. Swab-only natural-tooth care is now a plausible inadequate alternative; no false idea that tube flushes clean the mouth remains.
Stable nausea during advancement prompts assessment and review of prescribed progression. Antiemetic use without reassessing tolerance does not justify continued advancement.

Comfortable soft alternate-day stool can be normal. Alternatives still share the same fixed-daily-frequency misconception, so difficulty is limited; no clinical or key defect identified in this narrow foundation item.
Key index2 is retained after shuffling. Gradual fibre plus appropriate fluid addresses abrupt-change bloating; changing to concentrated fibre at the same sudden amount does not fix the cause.

Secure foot support corrects the explicit dangling-feet barrier. Forward lean without support and further seat elevation are credible incomplete ergonomic changes; more straining does not fix posture.

reviewScope: Only the ten previously revised IDs were re-read. Unchanged IDs retain prior matching-hash review; they are deliberately not relabelled here.
